body:
[PTL · post-restart A/B/C scoped ownership]

CONTROL MODEL · Adopt current three-lane structure from5968493382/5968493573. Delivery Executor01a0ff01 remains SOLE integrator for shared hotspot files:
- src/routes/agent-v1-turn.ts
- src/orchestrator-v5/agent-lane/runtime/agent-capabilities.ts
No lane owner may independently land overlapping hotspot edits.

A · STATE + CONTEXT + ORCHESTRATION
OWNER · existing B3 owner01a0fec3.
FIRST CONTRACT · selected-current-Run context parity on served ef65:
- canonical selected Run identity is the only source for analysis/currentness facts;
- selected-Run limits/constraints/leader-risk permission state must agree across ordinary follow-up context, Explain and cold/current reads;
- preserve SharedData as sole permission/finalizer authority;
- preserve B3 currentness/provenance and no raw leader_claim grant path;
- consume Context2529 census5967964510: all six original hunks survive, but option_participation is already carried and must NOT be rebuilt;
- SCI tipping-point handoff5963981266 is included only as typed selected-current-Run fact, never as a permission/freshness authority.
LEASE · A may produce exact surviving patch/fixture/test material and edit FILE-DISJOINT owned support files only. For either hotspot above, A returns an integrator-ready hunk; Executor applies/integrates it. No parallel hotspot branch.
ACCEPTANCE · ordinary/current-read Explain parity + stale/missing/degraded controls + CTX-05 limit/constraint/leader-risk facts, with no new authority.

B · ACTION / MUTATION + VERSIONED WORKSPACE
OWNER · existing B1 owner01a0fcdb.
FIRST ACTION · READ-ONLY survivor census first, then stop for bounded write authorisation.
INPUTS · verified B1 local bundle19bf3 + remote2524@8d5ae397 + Core2530@7b32078b + B4#2532@52f3730c.
FIRST CONTRACT TO CLOSE · one generic explicit-approval lifecycle:
proposal/intent → explicit user approval → exactly one canonical durable write → reread same committed state → analysis stale where analysis-affecting state changed → rerun → typed delta/version identity.
MUST distinguish proposal/approved/committed; no “approved = applied”; no second permission/write authority; no raw UI semantic mutation.
CENSUS OUTPUT · SURVIVORS · SUPERSEDED · CONFLICTS · CANONICAL WRITE OWNER · VERSION/DELTA BOUNDARY · TESTS · proposed file lease.
No implementation until Executor/PTL consumes that census. Hotspot edits remain Executor-only.

C · SCIENCE-GROUNDED REASONING
OWNER · existing SCI-HERO01a0feed.
FIRST CONTRACT · truthful typed current-Run tipping interaction:
- tipping fact must be bound to the selected current Run and actual factor identity;
- no tipping fact if maths/currentness does not support one;
- user-visible proposed action must reference the same factor/Run truth;
- no state change without explicit user action;
- stale after approved analysis-affecting change; fresh result only after rerun;
- no fabricated VOI/EVPPI/Worth-resolving-next.
SCI_CHANGE2522 remains HELD unless C proves a concrete maths/currentness defect requiring that existing lane; do not release it merely to add breadth.
LEASE · source/fixture work must stay file-disjoint from Executor hotspots. Any hotspot hunk is handed to Executor for integration.

REVIEW MODEL · Each lane reaches REVIEW_READY with focused controls + ONE independent Codex pre-review and zero unresolved P1. Executor then integrates shared hotspots once and obtains ONE final integration/release verdict. Do not stack independent HIGH branches.

HARNESS/R3 · Cross-cutting acceptance only. No implementation owner is currently attested, so do not fabricate staffing or revive stopped automation. Executor owns sequencing/receipt consumption only until an existing harness owner explicitly ACKs. Each meaningful served slice must be witnessed before dependent HIGH stacking.

CANVAS · Existing Canvas Builder recovery923/full-gate route already dispatched and remains separate. No second Canvas actor.

ORDER · A first because it establishes context truth used by B/C. B census and C typed-science contract may proceed in parallel where file-disjoint. B implementation waits on census ruling; C SCI_CHANGE waits on demonstrated need.
